item.text:
“the stakes for our movement has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our movement have never been higher”

“federal goverment” >>> “federal government”

“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”

“three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named.]

“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”

“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”

“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”

“directly effect every company” >>> “directly affect every company”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified earlier as R-OH.]

“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty” >>> [CHECK: The earlier summary specifies $1 million per day; “keeps” implies the amount is unchanged.]

“who's support” >>> “whose support”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”

“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: These counts total 29, not the stated 28 members.]

“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow.” >>> [CHECK: Five senators are listed, but six are claimed. Ames is later described as undecided, and Kowalski's voting position is unclear; reconcile the list and counts.]

“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”

“after the September 23 hearing” >>> [CHECK: The timeline dates the committee hearing to September 30. Are these different hearings, or is one date wrong?]

“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”

“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached.” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached.”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”

“occured on September 30” >>> “occurred on September 30”

“would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The Section 6 summary specifies 18 months, not two years. Also confirm whether the requirement is to conclude negotiations or merely to negotiate.]

“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”

“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”

“call there senators” >>> “call their senators”

“recieve updated talking points” >>> “receive updated talking points”

“Each of our five field organizers” >>> [CHECK: The preceding paragraph says there are six field organizers.]
